name: Bootstrapper
description: Lightens Roblox clients for running many accounts: limits every client except the focused one with a profile: CPU cap, RAM cap, CPU cores, CPU and GPU priority, efficiency mode, and memory priority, and can cap the frame rate through Roblox's own Maximum frame rate setting. Can show where each joined server is, looked up on ipinfo.io. Windows only. Reads the Roblox logs on this device and sends only server addresses to ipinfo.io, while server location is on.
